rows.Origin:
Bred by G. Delbard (France, 1996).
Introduced in Australia by Wagner's Rose Nursery in 2022 as 'Bordure Magenta'.
rows.Bloom: Fuchsia / magenta. Mild fragrance. Small, double (17-25 petals), cluster-flowered, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Height: 2' to 5' (60 to 150cm). Width: 16" to 2' (40 to 60cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
